title: HELIX Compensation Resource
description: An employee compensation record — base pay, rate, grade/step, and compa-ratio. Restricted: individual pay data accessible only to HR and leadership.

helix_id.description: HELIX-assigned unique identifier for this Compensation record.

base_pay.description: Annualized base salary or hourly rate × standard hours.

pay_rate.description: The actual rate: salary amount or hourly rate.

pay_rate_type.description: Map: 'Salary' → 'salary', 'Hourly' → 'hourly'. Bound to HELIX terminology: helix/compensation-type.

compensation_step.description: Direct map if applicable. Null for non-step plans.

grade_minimum.description: Direct map. Bottom of the pay range.

grade_maximum.description: Direct map. Top of the pay range.

compa_ratio.description: Ratio of actual pay to midpoint. <1.0 = below market, >1.0 = above.

effective_date.description: Cast to ISO 8601. The date this compensation became effective.

meta.description: HELIX metadata block — present on every resource.
